distro.about: Oracle's October 2026 Critical Patch Update (20 Oct): 98 MySQL fixes, 29 of them reachable without a login, the worst through the bundled curl and OpenSSL (9.8) and Group Replication (CVE-2026-101781, 8.8); fixed in 8.4.13 and 9.7.4. Oracle's 17 Nov patch update, which these versions don't fix, is its own row. MySQL 8.0 reached end of life in April 2026: Ubuntu still backports fixes into 8.0.46, Oracle's own 8.0 builds get none. None known exploited

distro.name: MySQL (17 Nov 2026 patch update)
distro.about: Oracle's 17 Nov 2026 patch update: CVE-2026-114952 (9.1), an authentication bypass in the client programs reachable over the network without a login, plus replication, optimizer, logging and GIS bugs (7.2 and below) in the server. 8.4.13, 9.7.4 and 26.10, the newest public releases, are affected; so far Oracle's fix is only for support customers, and no distro has shipped it. None known exploited; the GitHub 'proof of concept' for CVE-2026-114952 is a version audit script, not an exploit
distro.mitigation: keep port 3306 reachable only from the hosts that need it, don't point MySQL client programs at servers you don't control, and update when your distro or Oracle's repo ships the 17 Nov fixes

electron.name: Electron apps
electron.about: Apps such as VS Code, Cursor, Slack, Postman and Claude carry their own copy of Chromium through Electron, which backports Chrome's security fixes only to its three newest major versions (43, 44 and 45 since 21 Oct 2026). An app built on an older Electron carries every Chrome bug fixed since, including those exploited in the wild such as CVE-2026-125350

chromium_cache.name: Puppeteer / Playwright Chromium
chromium_cache.about: Browsers that Puppeteer and Playwright download never update themselves, and Playwright starts Chromium with the sandbox off unless told otherwise. Puppeteer 25.16.0 (Chromium 156.0.8078.47) still ships a build older than 157.0.8103.50; Playwright 1.65.0 ships 158.0.8127.18 but still turns the sandbox off. CVE-2026-87491 and CVE-2026-85046: V8 bugs exploited in the wild (CISA KEV), fixed in 153.0.8010.36; on macOS also CVE-2026-106378, a GPU sandbox escape fixed in 155.0.8059.39; and four critical bugs fixed on 27 Oct 2026 in 156.0.8078.73 (CVE-2026-118306 escapes the sandbox, CVE-2026-118331/118348/118344 run code inside it); and 196 bugs fixed in 157.0.8103.38 (stable on Linux 3 Nov, macOS 5 Nov 2026), 33 of them critical, several running code outside the sandbox (e.g. CVE-2026-121035, CVE-2026-121086, CVE-2026-121189); and CVE-2026-125350, a use-after-free in XML exploited in the wild, fixed on 9 Nov 2026 in 157.0.8103.50

mcp.name: Deprecated MCP servers

agent.name: AI agent setup
agent.about: Not CVEs: MCP servers fetched fresh on every start, coding agents allowed to run any command, SSH keys without a passphrase and .env files in folders an agent works in. Anything an agent can be tricked into doing runs with your files and keys.

iocs.cleanup: isolate this machine, review and run Cursor's remediate-macos.sh as your user (not root), remove the svc-telemetry key and persistence, consider a rebuild, then rotate every credential and session it could reach from a clean machine

skills.name: AI agent: skills
skills.about: Static audit of installed agent skills (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, ~/.agents): hidden instructions, invisible characters, pipe-to-shell installs, downloaded programs, credential reads, persistence, obfuscation, exfiltration endpoints, hard-coded secrets and authors Snyk confirmed malicious. Snyk's ToxicSkills scan of 3,984 skills (mostly ClawHub, Feb 2026) found 36.8% with a security issue, 13.4% critical and 76 confirmed malicious.
